name: prepare_read_typed_fields
description: Prepare a one-call read of text-capable inputs and textareas in unwatched documents. Returns the exact field-label question without values; pass its approval to read_typed_fields.  Effect: change. Pass the service-provided approval unchanged, including its first field question, operation_id and complete description; never write or amend the question yourself.

name: read_typed_fields
description: Read the listed text-capable inputs and textareas once after the exact prepared question is approved. Credentials always remain unreadable. The connection, frames, reader and exact field identities are bound; changes refuse and require a fresh question; ordinary reads retain filled/empty.  Effect: read. Pass the service-provided approval unchanged, including its first field question, operation_id and complete description; never write or amend the question yourself.

name: tabs
description: List all tab titles, addresses, native window/position, active/focused state and Claude-group membership; no page content is read. Effect: read.

name: downloads
description: List Chrome downloads and the paths Chrome chose. Changes nothing; Chrome saves normally. Effect: read.

name: bookmarks
description: Find bookmark addresses and titles, read-only. Effect: read.

name: history
description: Find visited addresses and titles, read-only. Effect: read.

name: take_tab
description: Take the chosen owner tab into the visible Claude group. Effect: change.

name: release_tab
description: End control and drop prepared work without dispatch. A cleanup_pending result means native restoration is still waiting; the owner must close its dialog or, if needed, the tab. Effect: change.

name: close_tab
description: Close only a Claude tab; prepared work is dropped. Effect: change.

name: open
description: Open a web address or about:blank in a new Claude tab. Navigation is free. Effect: change.

name: navigate
description: Navigate a Claude tab by address or one history direction. Only http, https and about:blank; settings and approval pages refuse. Effect: change.

name: read
description: Read a compact structural page tree with roles, names, safe values, states and boxes; passwords are excluded before extraction. Views are paged at 16000 characters. Effect: read.

name: find
description: Find visible text across readable frames. Returns exact references and a bounded page. Effect: read.

name: read_form
description: Read every field and option of one form, including hidden fields and password presence only. Effect: read.

name: wait
description: Wait for text or a stable view, then return the page; never acts. Effect: read.

name: click
description: Click this exact control once if free, or prepare asking input without clicking. Effect: change.

name: fill
description: Replace field text; line breaks insert text, never Enter keys. A page-started submission is prepared separately. Effect: change.

name: select
description: Choose one exact option; classifies before input and checks any page-started submission. Effect: change.

name: check
description: Set one checkbox or radio state, with expected current state. Effect: change.

name: press
description: Press a key on this control. Enter in compose and Delete outside editing ask; focused send controls ask for Enter and Space. Effect: change.

name: scroll
description: Scroll at this element by CSS pixels. Effect: change.

name: upload
description: Prepare uploading a caller-side immutable file snapshot. Path and hash appear in approval; never opens a home path in the service. Effect: change.

name: fill_form
description: Fill exact fields in order, classifying each separately. Stops at the first prepared or stopped step and reports completed fields; never replays earlier input. Effect: change.

name: dialog
description: Answer or dismiss Chrome alert, confirm or prompt. Accepting listed confirmation text prepares its own operation unless exactly named by an approved site adapter. A dialog opened through an outside native function always asks with its exact chosen answer and an unguarded-continuation warning, with no trusted exemption. A dialog already open before taking the tab is handed to the owner within a bounded wait; ask him to answer it himself. Effect: change.

name: submit
description: Run exactly the prepared operation after approval, with question first and unchanged. Rechecks bound page state, dispatches once; no automatic retries. Effect: send. Pass the service-provided approval unchanged, including its first field question, operation_id and complete description; never write or amend the question yourself.

name: submit_trusted
description: Run a prepared adapter kind only if the owner-only exact-site/account/parameters entry still allows it. No prompt; deleting, paying and WhatsApp messages always refuse. Effect: send. Pass the service-provided approval unchanged, including its first field question, operation_id and complete description; never write or amend the question yourself.

name: drop
description: Cancel only reserved work; its stopped page step stays stopped and no input is dispatched. Effect: change.

name: operation_status
description: Read committed stages and uncertainty. checked then dispatched, followed by what the page showed; nothing is replayed. Effect: read.

name: notices
description: Read every Chrome warning occurrence through bounded pages, including open checks after a storage failure. Acknowledgement and action outcome are separate. Effect: read.

name: notice_ack
description: Acknowledge one warning occurrence. Unresolved actions remain pending. Effect: change.
